Who We Are

We Bring Technologies To Your Life

Our expertise is in how to integrate technology with business to make your company more profitable.

Discover

Services

Responsive Websites

I build websites that work on all devices ranging from smart phones to tablets to PC/Macs.

Oracle DBA

Monitor and optimize, manage, backup and secure your databases.

Google Analytics

Monitor and improve how people are finding your site, where they go, and for how long.

Social Media

Dominate your online social media presence to drive business and have better customer interactions.

Google Maps Listing

Make sure your site is listed in Google Maps with all the correct business information.

QR Codes

Capture business cards or send customers to your website with a couple of clicks on a cell phone.

Tech Advice

Gain a comprehensive purchase and use strategy of hardware and software to maximize your business costs and benefits.

Search Engine Optimization

Make sure that your site is found by using Search Engine Optimization (SEO) techniques.

NFT Creation

Create and sell NFTs while marketing your business in a new way, gaining equity and a recurring revenue stream.

Virtual Tours, 3D Models, & Floorplans

Let us create a Virtual Tour that shares your space in an interactive and engaging way.

Google Maps Listing

People often use Google Maps to find businesses on their computers and smart phones. Google Maps list everything from location, business description, phone numbers, website location, and even pictures of your business or logo. If that information is incorrect, customers could be lost. For example, if a restaurant's hours are posted incorrectly, and a customer drives a distance to get there only to find the restaurant is closed, they will be quite upset. It is also important to link your business website to Google Maps for added benefit to the customer and to help your search engine optimization (SEO).

item.title: Google Analytics
item.dc:creator: smarternerdadminn
item.content:encoded:
Google Analytics

I use Google Analytics to monitor a site's success. This service can track where a customer lands on the site, what search words they used, which site they came from, their geographical location, what language they speak, what operating system they use, and whether it is a computer or mobile device. For example, a customer from California searched for a computer consultant on Google and it brought them to thesmarternerd.com. From there, Google Analytics can also show how long a customer stays on a page, and where they went after that.

This information can be very useful for Search Engine Optimization (SEO). It is crucial that the appropriate customer finds your site, so that you don't waste precious time on people that your company cannot provide service or products to. For example, if your company builds homes, you would not want children searching for ginger bread homes to find your site. Or, if your company can only handle local business in Hometown, USA, you may not want people from overseas finding your site.

item.dc:creator: smarternerdadminn
item.content:encoded:
Social Media

Social Media is taking the world by storm. Many businesses wonder how social media can benefit their business and, therefore, opt out. However, more and more people are using sites like Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, and YouTube to communicate, search for businesses, and do research on their interests. It is also important to control the Google Map listing of your business where you can report things like your business description, hours of operation, link to your website, phone number, etc.

 

I can create these pages for your business, which will allow a larger variety of people to find your site though these different mediums. Also, it will make your customers feel like you connected to them on a more personal level.

item.title: Search Engine Opimization
item.dc:creator: smarternerdadminn
item.content:encoded:
Search Engine Optimization

Everyone wants their site at the top of all search engines. However, knowing how you want your site is very important. I help customers tune this information so that the right customer with the right credentials from the right area finds your site.

 

If your business only deals in local business, then that is where we want the search engines to focus. Otherwise, you are local competing in a global market. Right now, there are over 640 millions active websites worldwide. Unless your SEO is done well, you may have a better chance at winning the lottery than you do having someone find your site.

 

There are many methods to helping this process succeed. Some of SEO involves the Web Site Design, along with Google Analytics to help improve the success rate. In addition, Social Media is taking off like crazy right now, which involves things like Instagram Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, etc.
